uiMainApp.eliteDowngradeMsgUC: Uma ou mais implantações <color=“red”>Elite</color> foram rebaixadas para um grupo <color=“green”>Regular</color>.

uiMainApp.fame1UC:
Se você terminar a missão antes do final da Rodada 7, poderá reivindicar o número de prêmios mostrado.

Após a missão, os prêmios podem ser usados para:
uiMainApp.fameItem1UC: • Compre uma carta de Item adicional de um baralho de Itens de sua escolha durante a fase de Melhoria Rebelde (custo: 1 Prêmio por carta).
uiMainApp.fameItem2UC: • Compre uma carta de Missão Secundária adicional e coloque-a em jogo como uma missão ativa (custo: 2 Prêmios por carta, máximo de 2 cartas).
uiMainApp.fame2UC: Quando o contador de rodadas chegar a 8, os prêmios da missão serão zerados.
uiMainApp.reinforceWarningUC: Não há grupos inimigos para reforçar ou a ameaça atual é muito baixa para reforçar qualquer grupo.
uiMainApp.deploymentWarningUC: Não há grupos inimigos para enviar ou a ameaça atual é muito baixa para enviar qualquer grupo.
uiMainApp.noRandomMatchesUC: Não há grupos correspondentes com custo {d} ou menos.

sagaMainApp.medpacInfoUC:
Um herói pode usar um Medpac quando realiza uma ação de descanso, e uma figura aliada pode usar um Medpac como uma ação.

Quando uma figura usa um Medpac, ela recupera 5 {H}. Os Medpacs podem ser encontrados em caixotes.

uiCampaign.threatInfoUC: O nível de ameaça é igual ao da missão jogada mais recentemente.
uiCampaign.campaignDescriptionUC: Embarque em uma campanha nova ou já existente pela galáxia.
uiCampaign.sagaDescriptionUC: Jogue uma missão única, orientada pela narrativa, com apresentação em mapa 3D.
uiCampaign.classicDescriptionUC: Jogue uma única missão usando o guia da campanha e sem mapa 3D.
uiCampaign.agendaImperialUC: O Império vê você como uma ameaça que precisa ser detida. Compre uma carta do Baralho de Missões Imperiais e coloque-a em jogo. Se for uma missão obrigatória, jogue-a imediatamente. Se for uma missão secundária, ela se torna uma missão secundária ativa.
uiCampaign.agendaRebelUC: O Império usa seus recursos em outros lugares. Nada acontece.

uiTacticalAI.apTreeHunter: Focus zone: the area the rebels' current mission objective points at – that is where the hunter hunts. ? Attack point available? Hero INSIDE the focus zone in range and clear line of sight? → attack him (several zone heroes? → the one with the higher threat value; EXPLAIN shows it). No zone hero reachable, but focus target in range + clear line of sight? → attack the focus target. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone resp. the zone hero. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone resp. the zone hero. The hunter's creed: a hero OUTSIDE the focus zone is not your target – ignore him, even when he blocks your path. Only whoever attacks YOU may reap your shot back this round; nobody is pursued for it.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeOfficerHunter: ? Attack point available? Order possible? → Which other Imperial figure in reach repositions up to 2 spaces, and where to: toward the focus zone, away from it, or sideways? – the Order spends your attack point and overrides the commanded figure's doctrine. No Order? → Zone hero (working the mission objective inside the focus zone) in range + clear line of sight? → attack yourself; otherwise the focus target, if shootable. Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeOfficerKeepHunter: ? Attack point available? Order possible? → Which other Imperial figure in reach repositions up to 2 spaces, and where to: toward the focus zone, away from it, or sideways? – the Order spends your attack point and overrides the commanded figure's doctrine. No emergency? → do not attack on your own. A self-initiated attack is allowed only in one of these emergencies: he is under fire; a hero stands directly beside him; the mission objective is acutely threatened and only he can intervene; or he is the last surviving Imperial group – then he may fight as his doctrine allows. Without an emergency: give your Order, stay in cover behind the group you gave the order to, and do not drift away from it – never move farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now; if no cover can be held, take one step back – never one forward. Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone – never moving farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces – never moving farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now.

uiTacticalAI.ordFocusFokuszone: — focus zone: {0} hunts the hero at the mission objective, not the nearest one
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainFokuszone: Focus zone: {0} works the mission objective – {1} (hunter, tier 3+) follows into the zone and leaves heroes outside alone; whoever attacks {1} may expect one shot back.
uiTacticalAI.docGuard: Guard (hold the zone, deny the paths, never be lured out)
uiTacticalAI.docAmbusher: Ambush (stay unseen until the first shot)
uiTacticalAI.overlordFallback: IA Tática - Overlord: o feed de mundo tático ainda não está ativo - o planejamento segue as regras de referência.
uiTacticalAI.specialAsPrinted: Special action: execute exactly as printed on the card.
uiTacticalAI.restLine: Leave this action unperformed: Imperial figures have no Endurance value, so resting would gain them nothing. The figure stays put.
uiTacticalAI.interactLine: Interact: perform an interaction the mission allows (e.g. open an adjacent door, unless the mission has locked it).
uiTacticalAI.focusWounded: he is wounded - finish him first (table damage tracker)
uiTacticalAI.focusFirepower: highest firepower among the remaining heroes (attack dice, then health)
uiTacticalAI.ordAbilitiesLane: Printed special abilities are the Imperium’s call: the attack action may include them exactly as printed (Rules Reference) – the Tactical AI proposes movement and attack only, because deciding “may” abilities needs the board it never sees.
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusDetail: Focus score: {0} = {1} ({2}); basis: {3}; next: {4} — printed hero-card values, wound marks and the mission goal are the only inputs.
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusBasisReaktion: retaliation for the shot on this figure
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusBasisWachzone: guard duty at the mission-critical object
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseShiftQM: Time runs out: the Imperium leaves its defensive posture and hunts — round {0} of {1} on the mission clock.
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseExplain: Phase: {0} -> {1} (mission clock in its final third).
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainWachzone: {0} is working at the mission-critical object in {1} — {2} acts first.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainThreeC: {0} pushed into the newly activated section {1} — {2} reacts first.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainVergeltung: {0} was shot at this round — {1} is suspected as the shooter.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainSupportMaske: {0} trusts its picture of {1} and takes aim at the hero reported there.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainSupportHalten: {0} holds its own section instead of guessing a target — the picture is still too diffuse.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainClamp: A hero is working at the mission-critical object — the units guard the objective instead of hunting the heroes.
uiTacticalAI.apHeadAssault: ACTION POINTS: {0} — OF WHICH ATTACK POINTS: {1} (MULTIPLE ATTACKS PRINTED ON YOUR CARD)
uiTacticalAI.apRule: Read top-down: the first branch answered YES is executed.

Then this point is movement: focus target still in range? → move into cover with your remaining movement. Focus target NOT in range → move up to {0} spaces toward it.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeGuard: Guard zone: the area of the mission where the rebels must complete their objectives (terminals, doors, objects) – that is where your guards stand. ? Attack point available? Hero in guard zone within range + clear line of sight? → attack. Otherwise check the focus target: attackable? → attack the focus target. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement (choose one option, no priority): up to {0} spaces, the move ends inside the guard zone (entering it from outside is allowed): advance toward the nearest hero, block another hero's path to the objective/escape point at a chokepoint or door – or hold your position. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement (choose one option, no priority): up to {0} spaces, the move ends inside the guard zone (entering it from outside is allowed): advance toward the nearest hero, block another hero's path to the objective/escape point at a chokepoint or door – or hold your position.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeBlocker: ? Attack point available? Focus target within range + clear line of sight? → attack the focus target. Line of sight blocked by another hero figure? → attack that blocking figure. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: up to {0} spaces onto a blocking space between the mission objective and the focus target (no focus target? → toward the nearest hero). ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: hold the blocking space between mission objective and focus target – or shift up to {0} spaces onto one.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeSupport: ? Attack point available? Softest target shootable from cover (range + clear line of sight)? → attack it. No soft target? → attack the focus target if shootable. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: step back into cover. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: step back into cover.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeAmbush: ? Attack point available? Ambush shot at the first hero you can shoot (range + clear line of sight)? → attack him. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: up to {0} spaces into new cover. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: relocate to a space no hero can see (up to {0}) – your next shot comes from new cover.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeTripod: Your card's printed rule: movement and shooting exclude each other. ? Attack point available? Nearest hero within reach (range + clear line of sight)? → attack him. No target? → stay on your space. ? Movement strategically necessary? Then: reposition up to {0} spaces – but only if you do NOT want to attack directly afterwards: any movement forbids attacks this round.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeNoTarget: ? Attack point available? Nearest hero within range + clear line of sight? → attack him. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the nearest hero. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the nearest hero – or move into cover.
uiTacticalAI.apEnd: ◆ ACTION POINT DONE — Points left? → Run the tree again from the top.

uiTacticalAI.ordInfoAttack: Attack: use a weapon or an ability.
uiTacticalAI.ordInfoDoor: Doors may be opened on the way to the objective - opening one costs an action (interact); locked doors only as the mission rules allow.
uiTacticalAI.ordInfoGuardZone: Guard zone = the area around the mission's objectives and terminals the rebels must reach. Its extent comes from the mission — the popup knows no zone tiles.
uiTacticalAI.ordInfoRule: Basic rule: an Imperial figure attacks only once per activation - unless its Imperial card explicitly allows several attacks. An unused action is lost; the figure simply stays put.

uiTacticalAI.personaCaptSignature: Subordinates: his elite - one stormtrooper steps in as a veteran, plus aggressive forward cover and one defensive line among the ranged groups.
uiTacticalAI.personaIsbSignature: Subordinates: his elite - a probe droid of the finest surveillance quality; ambushes and shock attacks increase, the defensive reserve holds on order.
uiTacticalAI.personaHuttSignature: Subordinates: bounty hunters and beasts first, his ambushes reach across the whole side - the dynasty escalates through the hunt.
uiTacticalAI.personaFeldherrSignature: Subordinates: his elite - an Imperial officer steps in as elite commander; aggressive pressure on every figure, the reserve holds.
uiTacticalAI.personaDroidenDirektorSignature: Subordinates: his elite - the probe droid and the E-Web step in in elite execution; barrages and reserve grow with the rank. Steel obeys.
uiTacticalAI.personaGrossmoffSignature: Subordinates: garrisons stay, veterans take the posts - his elite steps in as stormtrooper and E-Web. In the end fear itself moves in.
uiTacticalAI.personaDelta0Hint: His elite replaces the regular figure: cost and figure count stay the same.
